tables.name: pages
tables.description: Pages. A page has a title and a written body, can nest inside another page, carries its own diagram, and can be a note, a journal entry, a task or an event on your timeline.

tables.name: links
tables.label: Links
tables.description: Wiki-link edges parsed from page bodies by the engine: fromId -> toId, one row per [[target]] found in a page's body. toId is the resolved target page id (empty when unresolved); toTitle keeps the raw [[target]] text so a later rename can re-resolve the link.

tables.name: bubbles
tables.label: Bubbles
tables.description: Bubble-board items. Each bubble belongs to one page's board (the page column).

tables.name: bubble_links
tables.label: Bubble links
tables.description: Lines between bubbles on one page's board (the page column).

tables.name: grafts
tables.label: Also filed under
tables.description: Extra places a page is filed: fromId is the branch page, toId the page that also appears under it (type graft). A page's parentId stays its one home; these rows add more places without moving it, and are never touched by the wiki-link index.

tables.name: tags
tables.label: Tags
tables.description: Your own tags. Give each a type (mood, project, place, habit...) to group them.

tables.name: days
tables.label: Days
tables.description: One row per day: an overall summary and mood for the whole day.

tables.name: prefs
tables.label: Settings
tables.description: Which features are on. A single row you tweak; not page data.

tables.name: habit_ticks
tables.label: Habit ticks
tables.description: One row per habit done on a day: page -> the habit page, date -> the day. Shaped as a page-keyed side table so a future 'tracker' page tool can own it.

tables.name: task_groups
tables.label: Task groups
tables.description: The groups of the agenda list: a name, a color and an order. A task points here from pages.groupId.
